overview: 1D/2D/3D array indexing, address arithmetic, strings, pointer to arrays, output prediction.
coreConcept: a[i] = *(a+i); 2D row-major: a[i][j] at base + (i*cols + j)*size.
hinglishExplanation: Pointer arithmetic element-size ke units me hota hai. Strings null-terminated. Multi-dimensional arrays row-major me store hote hain. p + p[3] - p[1] jaise expressions me char ki ASCII value use hoti hai.
formalDefinition: a[i] = *(a+i); 2D row-major: a[i][j] at base + (i*cols + j)*size.
